Oh Dear Lord. I am SO GRATEFUL for this summer, but after living through last year’s 112 degree heat in PORTLAND…this anchor is clueless. #ClimateCrisis is real, we are experiencing it, & it is fatal for people & places.

@DiJohnson15 Intellectually, I know I’m not *personally* responsible for #ClimateChange, but I try not to contribute any more than I have to. We have multiple sheets/curtains over our windows & doors while the sun is up. At night we open things up & run fans. It’s still at least 80 inside.
